subject: March usage surge — allocation & VAT handling
messages:
From: Alex Long <alex.long@brightcart.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 6 Apr 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: March usage surge — request for allocation and VAT clarification

Hi Priya,

Hope you're well. We noticed a ~4.5x spike on the March invoice (invoice ID BC-778) compared to February. The line items show a large number of 'streaming tokens' attributed to our account between 03/12–03/14 — we don't have any known traffic that would explain that. Can you help clarify: which sub-account / API key the tokens were billed to, whether any retries/duplicate requests were counted, and how VAT was applied (we're EU-headquartered with Reverse Charge in scope).

I've attached our invoice and a quick export from our side (billing-export-202603.csv). We need a breakdown for our finance and to reconcile with our ERP. If you could also provide a short CSV with request IDs or session IDs for the large spikes, that'd be ideal.

Thanks — can we get this by Fri 4/9 so we can close our month?

Alex Long
Head of Finance, BrightCart
finance@brightcart.com

Attachments: 202603-invoice-BC-778.pdf, billing-export-202603.csv

From: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
To: Alex Long <alex.long@brightcart.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 6 Apr 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: March usage surge — request for allocation and VAT clarification

Hi Alex — thanks for flagging and for the attachments. I'm sorry for the surprise. We're opening an internal tracing ticket to pull request-level telemetry for 03/12–03/14 and will look specifically for: duplicated request IDs, retry storms, and spikes tied to any model rollout or internal jobs.

Two quick asks from our side to speed this up:
- Can you confirm whether anyone on your team rotated API keys or performed a mass ingest (S3 -> API) in March?
- Is BrightCart claiming Reverse Charge (no VAT) for this invoice? If yes, please re-send your VAT registration number so we have it on file.

I'll loop in Ben from billing to coordinate the CSV output and to discuss provisional credit if we confirm duplicate counting. Targeting an initial update by Wed 4/8 EOD and a reconciliation by Fri.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 7 Apr 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: March usage surge — request for allocation and VAT clarification

PRIYA / MARISSA — forwarding Alex's note. Quick notes from Billing side after a first-pass on ledger: there are 3 candidate causes to check:
1) An internal migration job we ran on 03/12 that used a service account (should have been excluded from billing) — possible mis-scope on config.
2) Avro-based replay on 03/13 that created duplicate request IDs across a batch window.
3) A model rollback that momentarily increased token multipliers for streaming endpoints on 03/14 (ops hit a warmup path).

Marissa — can you pull the request-id trace for 03/12–03/14 and filter by customer_id=BRIGHT-4421 and api_key hash prefixes reported on the invoice? We need the raw request IDs + approximate timestamps. If we confirm duplicates, we should plan a provisional credit and a follow-up invoice adjustment.

Ben

Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2026 10:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: March usage surge — request for allocation and VAT clarification

Team — pulled traces and attached the filtered CSV (usage-trace-202603.zip contains request_id, timestamp, api_key_prefix, model, tokens_in, tokens_out). Quick summary of findings:
- 03/12 03:15–05:40 UTC: large batch of requests from api_key prefix "rk_7f3" — these map to an internal migration job that should have been tagged as "internal": we missed an exclusion rule. ~1.9M tokens.
- 03/13 14:40–15:10 UTC: replay job produced repeated request IDs (duplicate_count ~42k) because the producer didn't increment the batch nonce after a restart.
- 03/14 02:00–02:30 UTC: transient model warmup multiplier inflated streaming token counts by ~1.4x for a set of endpoints (we've already reverted).

Recommendation: propose a pro-rata credit that removes the migration job's tokens and de-duplicates the replay duplicates. That equals a provisional credit of $31,125 (pre-VAT). For VAT: since BrightCart is claiming Reverse Charge, we should reissue the invoice with net amounts and note reverse-charge if they provide VAT reg. number.

I'll prepare the adjusted token CSV and a redlined invoice. If everyone agrees, Priya, can you propose the credit to Alex and request VAT registration?

Marissa Cole
Billing Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: usage-trace-202603.zip

From: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
To: Alex Long <alex.long@brightcart.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: March usage surge — request for allocation and VAT clarification

Hi Alex — thanks for your patience. We've completed the trace and identified three contributing causes (internal migration job, replay duplicates, and a short model warmup multiplier). Attached are: the filtered request-level CSV (billing-export-202603-adjusted.csv inside usage-trace-202603.zip), a redlined invoice showing the provisional credit calculation, and a short note on VAT handling.

Summary and proposed next steps:
- Provisional credit (pre-VAT): $31,125 to offset duplicated/mis-scoped tokens.
- Invoice re-issue: We'll reissue the March invoice net of the provisional credit.
- VAT handling: If BrightCart confirms Reverse Charge and provides VAT reg. number, we will issue the corrected invoice with 0% VAT and include the reverse-charge reference. If you cannot provide VAT number, standard VAT will be applied and we can discuss a post-issue VAT adjustment upon documentation.
- Timeline: We can issue a corrected invoice by Mon 4/12.

Please confirm the VAT registration number and acceptance of the provisional credit so we can finalize. If BrightCart prefers a separate credit memo rather than a reissued invoice, we can do that as well — tell us your accounting preference.

Thank you — we apologize for the disruption and will follow up with the accounting docs.

Best regards,
Priya Natarajan
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com

Attachments: usage-trace-202603.zip (billing-export-202603-adjusted.csv inside), 202603-invoice-BC-778-redline.pdf, signed_msa_brightcart.pdf
